cycle: WRITE-IN-3 unpark of 006 broader / second evaluation. Owner: make the sciences. Scout docs/reports/2026-09-09-scout-002-003-006.md section 006. Spec docs/specs/2026-09-09-writein3-spec.md section 3.9 defaulted to PARK unless a cheap public pair existed; this file is the missing pre-registration.
status: written before any Open LLM Leaderboard shard was downloaded or any 2x2 / min-flip number was computed. No result file exists in this directory at write time.

ledger_state.identity_file: source-tree/006-flip-fragility-audit/ has claim-register.md and review-checklist.md; no IDENTITY file
ledger_state.bound_s1_s4: source-tree/006-kg-llm-reasoning/audit20260907/ is bound E-AUDIT-S1..S4; this tree must not overwrite those receipts
ledger_state.rejected_on_disk_runs: source-tree/006-kg-llm-reasoning/results/ and results_longtail/ are the 2026-07-13 handwritten-caption runs whose 0.944 multimodal cell is used=false (ledger F-02 / A-13). They are not a second evaluation.

question: Does Feinstein's minimum-flip count, applied to direction and to the exact-McNemar verdict separately, still find single-record or few-record fragility on a public paired binary evaluation whose n is tens of times larger than the paper's n=18 image-subset contrasts?

pair_selection_rule.rule: official-org closest-to-S3-judge-family, frozen before per-item scores are read

arm_a.why: Official Qwen 7B on the public old Open LLM Leaderboard. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct details do not exist on that leaderboard (search empty). Closest official Qwen to the paper's S3 judge qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q8_0.

arm_b.why: Official Meta Llama-3 8B Instruct. Closest official Llama instruct to the paper's S3 judge llama3.1:8b-instruct-q8_0.

pair_selection_rule.run_rule: for each (model, task), use that model's latest dated folder that contains the task's details_harness parquet. Do not mix items across runs of the same model on the same task. Different tasks may come from different dated runs of the same model.
pair_selection_rule.not_used_for_selection: download counts, published aggregate accuracies, and the Qwen-7B README 'latest results' block that was visible on the dataset card during repo discovery

excluded.hellaswag: each shard listed >50 MB (Qwen 62.6, Llama 52.9); size gate, decided from filename listings before download, not from scores
excluded.mmlu_hendrycksTest: 57 subject shards; not needed for the smallest registered family
excluded.drop: Qwen-only on the 2023-11-15 run; no paired Llama shard in the intersection

tasks.note_on_scout_mmlu: Scout named MMLU / GSM8K / ARC. ARC and GSM8K are in. MMLU replaced by Winogrande (both models have a <2 MB shard) to keep the family at 3 contrasts without 57 extra files.

alignment.row_index_fallback: only if both sides have identical n and no usable id/text key
alignment.overlap_kill: if inner-join n < 0.95 * min(n_a, n_b), drop that contrast; do not impute

correctness_extraction.cast: bool(value > 0.5) for numeric; bool(value) for bool/str CORRECT
correctness_extraction.no_new_labels: use only the stored harness 0/1; do not re-grade, do not call a judge, do not write answers

endpoints.per_contrast: n, cells (a,b,c,d), acc_arm, acc_ref, exact two-sided McNemar p, kappa_dir=|b-c|, kappa_ver closed form, kappa_ver BFS, floor, Holm-adjusted p over the family of contrasts that survive alignment
endpoints.primary_family: the 3 tasks above after alignment filters; Holm over that family only
endpoints.cross_check: kappa_ver closed form must equal BFS on every retained table; mismatch => that contrast is not reported and the run is marked CROSS_CHECK_FAIL

reading_rules_prestated.K1: if every retained contrast has kappa_ver >= 5 AND kappa_dir >= 5: the paper's 'single-record fragile at n=18' does not transport to these n~1000 public pairs. Report that. Do not weaken or restated the bound 18-contrast findings.
reading_rules_prestated.K2: if any retained contrast has kappa_ver <= 2: the statistic still finds a verdict that rests on one or two gradings on at least one public pair. Report the count. This is a transport observation, not a ranking of the two models.
reading_rules_prestated.K3: if any retained contrast has |kappa_dir - kappa_ver| >= 4 (and both finite): direction vs verdict disagreement transports. Same reporting rule as the paper's A-04/A-05 observation, on this family only.
reading_rules_prestated.priority: K1, K2, K3 may all fire or none; they are not mutually exclusive. None of them authorises a model-better headline.

forbidden: headline that Qwen-7B or Llama-3-8B-Instruct is better
treat this family as a replacement for the bound 18-contrast evaluation
use results/ or results_longtail/ handwritten-caption runs

compute.download: HEAD then GET of the six listed parquets via fetch_gate.py with SC_FETCH_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890; abort a shard if Content-Length is missing or >1 GiB; per-file auto-allow if <=10 MiB

licence_note: Open LLM Leaderboard details datasets are public leaderboard artefacts (old space). Underlying benchmarks: ARC (CC-BY-SA), GSM8K (MIT), Winogrande (CC-BY). This tree stores only the downloaded shards and derived 2x2 counts; it does not claim a new benchmark score.
